instruction.text: Which material should not be used to make a window?

b.sound: fabric can’t be seen through like glass.

instruction.text: Which material should not be used to make a bucket?

b.sound: paper would get soggy when you filled the bucket.
paper would get stiff and break.

instruction.text: Which material should not be used to make a book?

b.sound: the pages would be too stiff and could break.
ceramic is too hot and the book would burn.

instruction.text: Which material should not be used to make a skirt?

b.sound: metal is too heavy and stiff.

instruction.text: Which material should not be used to make a toilet?

b.sound: glass would let you see through into the toilet. yuck!
sitting on a glass toilet would be way too cold.

instruction.text: Which material should not be used to build a bridge?

b.sound: fabric isn’t strong enough and you might fall into the water.
fabric isn’t stretchy enough to reach the other side.

instruction.text: Which material should not be used to make a teacup?

b.sound: some plastic can melt if it gets too hot.
plastic can give tea a spicy flavour.
